assumptions.puja: Shashthi 17 Oct to Dashami 21 Oct 2026 (Bengal panchang)
assumptions.gym: 17:00-19:00 Mon-Sat (configurable; skipped on Sunday and during Puja)

phases.name: Habit-building
phases.description: Light 2-3 h/day study, ramping up. Goal: consistency, diagnostic papers (1 CS + 1 DA), refresh of basics (probability, matrices, C/Python, GA). Job hunt 08:00-10:00 and gym stay fixed.

phases.name: Durga Puja break
phases.description: Shashthi 17 Oct to Dashami 21 Oct (Bengal panchang; pan-India Dashami 20 Oct). Minimal load: 15-30 min recall/flashcards only; guilt-free rest.

phases.name: Re-entry ramp
phases.description: Post-Puja ramp: job hunt resumes, 1.5-2.5 h study, set up Week 1 of the full plan.

phases.name: Full plan I - shared core + CS foundations
phases.description: Plan weeks 1-6: probability, distributions, linear algebra, calculus, DS, algorithms, DBMS, DA warehouse; first timed sectionals; first CS sectional on Sat 28 Nov. 6-6.5 h/day on weekdays.

phases.name: Full plan II - DA ML/AI + CS systems
phases.description: Plan weeks 7-10: regression/classification/clustering/PCA/NN, AI; Digital Logic, COA, OS, Networks start; alternate DA and CS sectionals on Saturdays.

phases.name: Full plan III - consolidation + full mocks
phases.description: Plan weeks 11-14: DA syllabus review, finish CS (Networks, TOC, Compiler), weekly (then twice-weekly) full papers, 3 h paper + 2 h analysis, PYQ rotation.

phases.name: Final taper
phases.description: No new topics. Short timed sets, GA, formula recall, error-log revision, sleep routine; logistics checks.

phases.name: Exam window + remaining revision
phases.description: Sat 6 Feb assumed first paper. Remaining exam-weekend days (7, 13-14, 20-21 Feb) and revision for the paper not yet written.
